CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The colour of the galaxies - the part of the picture you would name. Driven over OSC by eclipse-dmx, so Nova is painted in whatever colour the truss is showing. This is the FIRST colour control in this list, which is what makes it /controls/global/color/1 - the positional address is the order these are declared in, so moving it down this list repoints the sender. Its default is the original's regime-0 teal.
CONTROLS.NAME: rig_color

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The wash the galaxies sit on. SECOND colour control, so /controls/global/color/2 and /controls/scene/rigcolor2. Only read when 'auto second' is off - nothing sends this yet; eclipse-dmx sends one fixture. Defaults to the original's regime-0 yellow.
CONTROLS.NAME: rig_color_2

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Derive the second colour as the complement of the first instead of reading rig_color_2. On by default, because one fixture is what the sender sends and a wash on the opposite side of the hue wheel is what the original pairs (orange galaxies on sky blue). Turn it off to drive both colours yourself.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_second

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: A first colour you set by hand, used instead of the rig's when 'Colour by hand' is on. This exists because a running sender overwrites rig_color thirty times a second, which makes it impossible to try a different colour while the link is live.
CONTROLS.NAME: manual_color

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Take the first colour from 'manual_color' instead of from the rig. Turn this on to prove the scene works independently of the link.
CONTROLS.NAME: color_by_hand

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How bright the wash behind the galaxies is, in the second colour. 0 is the black background of the original's regimes 2 and 3; 1 is a full wash like regimes 0 and 1; above 1 blows it out the way regime 0 did.
CONTROLS.NAME: base_amount

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn up to simplify the scene into a few splotches of color.
CONTROLS.NAME: simplify

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 'Zooms Out' when turned up, causing a grainy effect like a sandstorm.
CONTROLS.NAME: sandstorm

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Cause the slopes of the texture to highlight on high percussive hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: flashing

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: While ON, pulses emanate outwards synced to the BPM of the song.
CONTROLS.NAME: pulsate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: A radial grid effect that emanates out from the center like rays of energy.
CONTROLS.NAME: radial_grid

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Rotates the main texture on the beat when set to ON. Standard slow rotation when set to OFF.
CONTROLS.NAME: beat_rotate

DESCRIPTION: Felix Woitzel's Nova with its palette taken from the rig: the galaxies are whatever colour the lights are showing, arriving over OSC from eclipse-dmx, and the other five colours of the look are derived from that one. Everything else is the original.
TITLE: Eclipse Nova
